future_round_rule: If the declared tail exceeds the numerical resolution of the implementation, increase its registered resample budget before inspecting that new round. Never reuse exposed dates as fresh confirmation.
gate: All original substantive gain gates must pass, together with a strictly positive lower bound under this additional round allocation. The original comparison summaries remain preserved.
limits: This is nominal Bonferroni alpha spending under bootstrap coverage assumptions, not an always-valid guarantee under arbitrary market dependence. Retain the three-day block sensitivity and disclose longer regime uncertainty.
reason: The user requested an open-ended search. Repeatedly testing new candidates until one wins must not silently replenish the nominal false-discovery budget. This stricter program-level requirement is fixed before the first independent outcomes are inspected.
round_allocation: Round j, starting at 1, receives 0.05 / 2**j. The infinite sum is 0.05. Within a round, split the allocation equally across its procedures and use two-sided intervals.
